propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar scan and .github/module-size-limit.txt cap file must be removed from git_metrics and replaced with config-driven [code_health] settings

module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count functions must compute metrics from scc_loc LOC analyzer result instead of file-system scan, returning Unavailable when analyzer is unavailable rather than fabricated zeros
Context passed to metrics computation must include scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction from [code_health] config in addition to repo_root, since, until
near-cap-count boundary condition must include files at the lower and upper edges of the near band (inclusive), excluding over-cap files
cap_change_events metric must be deregistered and oversized_module_count seed stub removed, leaving only the analyzer-derived spec with structural provenance and 2026-01-01 accruing_since
